title: WaveletECO: A Closed-Loop Physical ECO Platform and a Specialized Local Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.23444v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Engineering change order (ECO) is an important step in repairing timing and electrical violations during the late stages of chip design. Existing Agentic EDA methods primarily focus on tool invocation, with less attention to model decision quality and targeted training. A central challenge in ECO is multi-round decision-making: the model must use the results of each round to determine the next repair action. We propose WaveletECO, which integrates a closed-loop execution platform with large language models to enable agents to execute ECO decisions effectively. We also train a local 9B model through supervised fine-tuning and CPO-SimPO using execution demonstrations and decision-preference data, enabling ECO decision-making with a locally deployed model. Across 594 evaluation runs on 22 designs, WaveletECO-Policy (BF16) and (INT8) score 79.63 and 79.65, respectively, compared with GPT-6 Astra's 77.44. The estimated inference cost of INT

translated_title: WaveletECO：一个闭环物理ECO平台与专用本地语言模型
translated_abstract: 工程变更单（ECO）是芯片设计后期修复时序和电气违例的重要步骤。现有的Agentic EDA方法主要关注工具调用，对模型决策质量和针对性训练的关注较少。ECO的一个核心挑战是多轮决策：模型必须利用每一轮的执行结果来确定下一个修复动作。我们提出WaveletECO，它将闭环执行平台与大语言模型相集成，使智能体能够有效执行ECO决策。我们还利用执行演示数据和决策偏好数据，通过监督微调和CPO-SimPO训练了一个本地9B模型，实现了基于本地部署模型的ECO决策。在22个设计上共594次评估运行中，WaveletECO-Policy（BF16）和（INT8）分别取得79.63和79.65的分数，而GPT-6 Astra的分数为77.44。INT的估计推理成本……
tldr: WaveletECO提出了一个与大语言模型集成的闭环物理ECO执行平台，并通过监督微调和CPO-SimPO训练出本地9B模型，在多轮ECO决策任务上以更低的推理成本超越了GPT-6 Astra。
